entries.title: A. Membership
entries.text: BRSA membership runs July–June. Day members may enter a single event and owe the class membership fee if they take a payout. Unpaid fines block the next entry.

entries.title: B. Classes
entries.text: Peewee, Junior, Youth, Adult, Senior, Open, Training and Futurity. A rider enters the class they are a member in. Carry-over is a second run on the same horse for an extra fee.

entries.title: C. Entries
entries.text: Entries close when the books are marked official. Pay-later names stay off the draw until the entry invoice is paid. Producers may take a late (guest) entry on the day.

entries.title: D. Draw
entries.text: The draw is a random shuffle of paid names. Draw numbers are posted before the first horse. A missing number is a producer warning, not an automatic scratch.

entries.title: E. Timing & divisions
entries.text: Section E.3: divisions 1D–5D are cut every 0.5 seconds off the fastest completed time in that class field. 1D is 0–0.49 seconds off the pace, 2D is 0.50–0.99 seconds off, 3D is 1.00–1.49 seconds off, 4D is 1.50–1.99 seconds off, and 5D is 2.00 seconds or more off the pace. Place is inside the division. A two-run jackpot keeps the better run.

entries.title: F. Dress & welfare
entries.text: Long sleeve, hat, collar. A welfare steward stands the gate. Abuse or an unsafe horse is a producer scratch and a possible fine.

entries.title: G. Points
entries.text: Five participation points plus 5–1 for places 1–5. Carry-over does not add a bonus. Futurity points sit on the horse; a carry-over credits the rider the same points as the horse.

entries.title: H. Payouts
entries.text: BRSA takes 30% of gross entry fees first. The remaining 70% is the payout pool. Producing / ground cost comes off that pool to leave the prize money. Wins apply to an unpaid membership invoice unless written off as cash.

entries.title: I. Protests
entries.text: Unofficial times stand for seven days. A rider may query a time. The producer can accept (re-open for re-timing), reject, or ask for more detail.

entries.title: J. Nationals
entries.text: Qualification is by class points across official events in the season. The rider Dashboard tracks the cut.

entries.title: K. Conduct
entries.text: Federation voice in the feed. Community is member-to-member. Boosts and gifts are optional and never buy a placing.

entries.title: L. Records
entries.text: Hall of Fame categories: BRSA Record, South African Record, Championship Win, Special Recognition. Category is required; the achievement line is free text.
